candidates.title: The opposing hands
candidates.description: The Silent faces a Corrupted Defect above their native card hands while the Architect looms between them. The Defect alone has a CPU/Pillow emulation of the native body shader at t=16.8 s, strength 0.75; the approved armillary stays at its original t=2.4 s and opacity 1.

candidates.title: The hand you left behind
candidates.description: A Corrupted Silent and her green card hand stand against the burning tower in an asymmetric character poster. The Silent alone has a CPU/Pillow emulation of the native body shader at t=16.8 s, strength 0.75; the approved armillary stays at its original t=2.4 s and opacity 1.

candidates.title: The Architect's court
candidates.description: The Architect towers over a Corrupted Regent, framed by an engraved bronze mechanism and blue staff fire. The Regent alone has a CPU/Pillow emulation of the native body shader at t=16.8 s, strength 0.75; the approved armillary stays at its original t=2.4 s and opacity 1.
